heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Do players need special hardware?
items.answer: No. Modern smartphones support AR with their built-in camera and sensors.

items.question: Can AR games work indoors?
items.answer: Yes. We design for the space players actually have.

items.question: Can you add AR to my existing game?
items.answer: In many cases yes. We assess your project and advise.

items.question: How long does augmented reality game development take?
items.answer: A simple casual game takes about 2 to 3 months, while a polished 3D or multiplayer game usually takes 6 months or more.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
